name: spend-meter
description: Know your API bill before it knows you. Hourly cost tracking and budget alerts for OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, on Cloudflare Workers.
author: Vikaranet (Pty) Ltd

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password for your dashboard at `/app`. Use any username to sign in.
